info.title: Caching dependencies in GitHub Actions CI

diffs.patch:
Index: .github/workflows/ci.yml
===================================================================
--- .github/workflows/ci.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/ci.yml	
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: .opencode
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: npm
+          cache-dependency-path: .opencode/package-lock.json
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Syntax-check plugin
+        run: node --check plugins/yul-auth-guard.js
